_comment: The two blocks that scripts/build-dashboard.sh splices into angular.json. Upstream has no `caios` tenant, so `ng build --configuration caios-production` fails without these. Modelled on the kmd4eosc-production blocks, which are the most recent flavour added upstream and therefore the best template.

caios-production._comment_styles: styles[0] MUST be the tenant theme and MUST come before src/styles.scss. variables.scss imports _material.scss on its first line.
caios-production._comment_assets: assets[0] maps the tenant image directory onto /assets/images/, which is where index.html looks for favicon.ico and the app looks for dashboard-logo.png. Order matters: the tenant glob must precede the generic src/assets glob.
